title: How to grade the accuracy of the BLAS
summary: Motivated by accelerating machine learning (ML), many computer vendors and chip manufacturers are building accelerators for matrix multiplication, which save time and energy by operating in the lower precisions needed for ML. This has in turn motivated many efforts to use these accelerators to provide faster matrix multiplication implementations with the higher precision required by many other linear algebra applications.
